headline: Iran Begins Early Gas Production at Gavarzin Field on Qeshm Island
summary: Iran launched early natural gas production from well No. 9 at the Gavarzin gas field on Qeshm Island, adding approximately 283,000 cubic metres of natural gas per day to regional supply.
why: Iran holds the world's second-largest natural gas reserves; domestic field developments aim to address severe winter gas shortages and feed petrochemical units.

impacts.name: Iran
impacts.why: Bringing well No. 9 online adds 283,000 cubic meters of daily gas production to southern Iranian distribution.
